bot.new: New conversation. The next message starts from nothing.
bot.not_permitted: Astra did not allow this plugin to send a message. Grant it "Send a chat message" in the plugin's settings.
bot.screenshot_failed: The screen could not be captured. The plugin log has the reason.
bot.screenshot_off: /screenshot is switched off. Turn on "Allow /screenshot" in the plugin's settings — it sends a picture of this machine's screen into this chat, so read what it says there first.
bot.screenshot_unsupported: /screenshot works on Windows only. This build of the plugin carries no screen capture, so there is nothing to switch on here — the rest of the bot is unaffected.
bot.send_failed: Astra could not answer. The plugin log has the reason.
bot.start:
Astra Telegram Bot is active.

Send any message and it goes to Astra; the reply appears here as it is written.

/new — start a new conversation, with no memory of this one
/screenshot — send a picture of the screen, if it has been switched on in settings
/stop — stop the reply being written; in a private chat the message has a Stop button of its own
/help — this message
config.allow_screenshot.description: Let /screenshot send a picture of this machine's screen into the Telegram chat. Windows only: on other systems the command says so and nothing else changes. Off by default: everything else the bot does is a conversation with an AI, and this is a live view of the desktop. Set Allowed Usernames before turning it on.
